questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(5, 14, 350)
questions.solution:
The Logic here is as follows:

**{(1st Number)² × 2ⁿd number} = 3rd Number**

**In **(5, 14, 350)

**{(1st Number)² × 2ⁿd number}**

= 5² × 14

= 25 × 14

= 350 **= 3rd Number**

Now check the all options,

**Option (1) **(8, 16, 340)

**{(1st Number)² × 2ⁿd number}**

= 8² × 16

= 64 × 16

= 1024 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (2) **(6, 12, 232)

**{(1st Number)² × 2ⁿd number}**

= 6² × 12

= 36 × 12

= 432 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (3) **(3, 20, 380)

**{(1st Number)² × 2ⁿd number}**

= 3² × 20

= 9 × 20

= 180 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (4)** (7, 9, 441)

**{(1st Number)² × 2ⁿd number}**

**= 7² × 9**

**= 49 × 9**

**= 441 = 3rd Number**

Hence, the correct answer is **"****(7, 9, 441)****".**

questions.question: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Select the odd one.
questions.solution:

Option (2) Architect → An architect is a person who plans, designs and oversees the construction of buildings, houses and etc.

Hence,** “Doctor”** is an odd one.

questions.question: The sum of the salaries of three persons, A, B and C, is ₹66,500. B's salary is half the salary of C. B's salary is 125% of A's salary. What is the salary of C?

options.text:
₹34,000

×
duplicate options found. English Question 1 options 2,3

questions.solution:
Given:

1) The sum of the salaries of three persons, A, B and C, is ₹66,500.

=> A + B + C = 66,500 **---------- eq. (i)**

2) B's salary is half the salary of C.

=> B = C / 2 **---------- eq. (ii)**

3) B's salary is 125% of A's salary.

=> B = 125% A

=> B = 5 / 4 × A

From eq. (i)

=> C / 2 = 5A / 4

=> A = 4C / 10 **---------- eq. (iii)**

**From eq. (ii) and eq. (iii) put the value of B and A in eq. (i)**

=> 4C / 10 + C / 2 + C = 66500

=> (4C + 5C + 10 C) / 10 = 66500

=> 19C / 10 = 66500

=> C = (66500 × 10) / 19

=> C = 665000 / 19

=> C = 35000

Hence, Salary of C is **“35000”.**
